fato_historico: 2012: A total of 315 people are killed in two garment factory fires in Pakistan.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider the fragility of life and the strength found in communal compassion. Much like stitching together the broken pieces of a garment, you may find that healing your own spirit involves tending to the comfort of those around you. It is a good time to protect your heart while offering warmth to others in need.
frase_do_dia: Kindness is the strongest thread that weaves us all together in this vast world.
significado_numero: A lucky number representing introspection and deep spiritual growth for you today.
conselho: Prioritize your peace and extend a helping hand to someone feeling overwhelmed today.
